summary: Hosted service, sprint 1v: draft quality and a clearer review, from the owner's latest staging re-walk. The author's new prompt states each fact once: Experience carries the detail, the summary condenses it in new words, and Core areas group evidence across roles. Validation now flags the same fact repeated across sections, a CV without a name or contact header, and an unlabelled Skills line, and a revision that loses a covered requirement gets a warning. The review names a brief's requirements and responsibilities apart in the start dialog, the Coverage tab and the relevance line, and the "Not ready" reasons are grouped with counts and name the failed check.
knownLimitations: Staging only: production keeps its earlier images until the owner deploys this tag there. Staging runs behind the owner token, so sign-in, plans and credits, and record export and deletion are not exercised there until the identity provider is hosted. The new author prompt has not had a paid run yet, so its effect on repetition is still to measure, as is the cost of a complete cached run (#1597). A word-match miss on a critical requirement still blocks approval until it is decided by hand.
